Re: Notice of Furnishing — Kestrel Plant 3 Expansion, 1400 Foundry Road, Akron, Franklin County, Ohio (Permanent Parcel No. 12-345678)

To the Owner and the Lender:

This is a Notice of Furnishing under Ohio Revised Code § 1311.05. It is given to preserve the lien rights of the undersigned.

1. The undersigned, Tallow Ridge Components, LLC, is furnishing labor and materials to the above project.

2. The undersigned was engaged by Meridian Steel Erectors, Inc., 44 Kent Street, Toledo, Ohio 43604, which is the subcontractor with which the undersigned contracted. The undersigned has no direct contract with the Owner.

3. The labor and materials being furnished are structural steel fabrication and erection hardware, first furnished on March 30, 2026.

4. The estimated total value of the labor and materials to be furnished is $412,500.

5. The property is described above by street address and permanent parcel number and is the property described in the notice of commencement recorded for this project.

NOTICE TO OWNER: THIS IS NOT A LIEN. IT IS A NOTICE THAT THE UNDERSIGNED IS FURNISHING LABOR OR MATERIALS TO YOUR PROPERTY AND MAY HAVE THE RIGHT TO FILE A MECHANICS' LIEN IF IT IS NOT PAID. YOU MAY WISH TO ENSURE THAT PAYMENTS TO YOUR CONTRACTOR REACH THE UNDERSIGNED.

Very truly yours,

TALLOW RIDGE COMPONENTS, LLC

/s/ Devon Achebe
Devon Achebe, Manager
